files.document_title: Magnum Gas Storage Project maps, proposed storage area, pipeline route and access roads, Entrix for Magnum
files.what_it_shows: Fifteen alignment sheets, maps A to O, at 1 inch to 2,000 feet on a USGS topographic base near Delta, Utah. Each shows the proposed pipeline centerline, right of way, mileposts, section lines and land ownership.
landmarks: match lines to maps B and C

files.document_title: Magnum Gas Storage Project maps, map A
files.what_it_shows: Page 1 of 15 rendered at 100 dpi. The storage site end of the line with township and section grid, State Route 174 and mileposts.
landmarks: match lines to maps B and C

searched: The oilandgaswatch record and its attached documents.
notes: The oilandgaswatch geometry is graded Medium by that site. The PDF has no text layer, so the URL checker cannot read words from it. It loads with status 200 and the map is a picture. The sheets carry a township and section grid, so a georeferencer can fit them closely if the vector needs checking.
